## Description After organization creation, Admins now land on **Quick start**, the first Admin menu item. The guide links to agent internet controls, OpenTelemetry audit-log setup, and invitations, with a full Markdown copy and manual fallback. IdP enrollment is marked **Planned**; external policies and delivery remain the Admin's responsibility. ## Review **T2 Need architect** — `Architecture: T0: no architecture fact`. Declared browser-contract and internal-interface changes require T2; sensitive behavior, the protected exception file, and two used MI exceptions also require review. Architecture facts (checker, `f5f8cd2` vs `feeaad4d`): - None; all 53 public declaration snapshots are unchanged. `.pr-impact.json` declares `contract`, `internalInterface`, and `sensitiveBehavior`; other flags are false. Registry prose is updated. Components, dependencies, deployment, and all 20 registry drawings are unchanged. **Merge status: blocked.** Local gates and checker are complete. Independent authorized architect approval of this candidate is the remaining blocker; agent review is not that approval. See [full checker](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/39d0052739c1d44e4b75f56253f6658be0be4f37/review/admin-quick-start/checker.md). ### Architecture comparison Supplementary L3, hosted Node-server L2 container; main merge base `feeaad4d5f04212f033366c232180be4bd40da4c` to candidate `f5f8cd2e3a2297d73a44fbc2974c6eee5a59d81e`: ```mermaid %%{init: {"theme": "base", "themeVariables": {"background": "#ffffff", "primaryColor": "#f5f5f5", "primaryTextColor": "#17181d", "primaryBorderColor": "#777777", "lineColor": "#777777", "edgeLabelBackground": "#ffffff", "clusterBkg": "#fafafa", "clusterBorder": "#777777", "fontFamily": "Arial, sans-serif", "fontSize": "15px"}, "flowchart": {"htmlLabels": true, "wrappingWidth": 180, "nodeSpacing": 28, "rankSpacing": 38, "curve": "linear"}}}%% flowchart TB browser["L2: browser application
Account links and guide display"] subgraph hosted["Thermus hosted Node server"] app["app · TypeScript
Compose hosted routes
Changed: supplies configured MCP URL"] web["web · TypeScript
Accounts and sign-in
Changed: Admin guide and creation landing"] organizations["organizations · TypeScript
Current membership authority"] workos["workos · TypeScript / SDK
Session, access, and directory"] app ==>|supplies roles and configured URLs| web web -->|current membership read| organizations web -->|session and current access| workos organizations -->|directory reads| workos end remote["External: WorkOS
Identity and organization records"] browser -->|HTTPS account requests| web workos -->|HTTPS / SDK| remote classDef changed fill:#fff4d6,stroke:#ae7700,stroke-width:2px,color:#17181d class app,web changed ``` - Confirmed activation and checked selection now lead to Quick start. Existing-access Continue, later login, workspace switching, and grant replay rules keep their behavior. - Current session, matching identity/organization, product access, exact Admin role, and an authorized nonblank organization name determine the guide. Query hints cannot choose its context. - App supplies trusted portal/MCP URLs. Escaped page/Markdown content contains no secrets. Copy success follows the clipboard write; failure exposes selectable text. - GET serves the guide; HEAD omits its body. Other methods return 405 for admitted Admins. Refused names return 403, provider failure returns 500, and cancellation produces no guide. [Rendered comparison and retained rationale](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/39d0052739c1d44e4b75f56253f6658be0be4f37/review/admin-quick-start/final-manager-review.md) cover omitted context and the L4 decision. --- Candidate: [f5f8cd2](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/commit/f5f8cd2e3a2297d73a44fbc2974c6eee5a59d81e) · [Validation](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/pull/289#issuecomment-6474821759) · [Quality review](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/pull/289#issuecomment-6474822296)

Every successful test run above reports zero failed, cancelled, skipped, or todo tests. The final-head static/build and combined browser refresh completed with exit 0 in session 73583; its raw logs replace the earlier manager-only Members/portal-build record. [Environment gate summary and exact commands](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/39d0052739c1d44e4b75f56253f6658be0be4f37/review/admin-quick-start/environment-gates/summary.md), [per-attempt identities/times/exits](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/39d0052739c1d44e4b75f56253f6658be0be4f37/review/admin-quick-start/environment-gates/summary.json), and [artifact hashes](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/39d0052739c1d44e4b75f56253f6658be0be4f37/review/admin-quick-start/environment-gates/artifact-sha256.json) retain the isolated gate provenance.

**Candidate compatibility.** Ordinary, initial focused and coverage evidence was captured for production candidate `e65d35020472dd6ee7fe2f4ec7b5b553441ef48a`. The final dedicated browser, standalone type check and portal-build refreshes ran at `f5f8cd2e3a2297d73a44fbc2974c6eee5a59d81e`. The environment gates used an isolated checkout of `e65d35020472dd6ee7fe2f4ec7b5b553441ef48a` with identical package/lock inputs. No production source or ordinary test input changed between `e65d3502` and final `f5f8cd2e`. Before the live gate, the exact manager-reviewed `test/acceptance/auth/hosted-live/signup-server.ts` overlay was copied into that checkout; SHA256 `785e337655eeb109a963368f1f440e84cefe637ef9512db75578509a8e97c68d`. It checks Quick start and selected organization/session context, then follows Open Connect setup before the existing connection assertions. Commit [`c8fe19169c61b72eea4cb97a4beac24f2e217429`](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/commit/c8fe19169c61b72eea4cb97a4beac24f2e217429) committed that tested helper plus inventory/impact metadata. Final `f5f8cd2` adds only the generated immutable base metrics record. [Tested overlay identity](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/39d0052739c1d44e4b75f56253f6658be0be4f37/review/admin-quick-start/environment-gates/04-workos-live-overlay.json) and [exact patch](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/39d0052739c1d44e4b75f56253f6658be0be4f37/review/admin-quick-start/environment-gates/04-workos-live-overlay.patch) preserve the pre-commit evidence.

**Failure and retry history.** Earlier evidence is retained as failed or rejected, not counted as passing:

- The first ordinary run had 5,682 passes and three stale navigation expectations: Members/Audit shared navigation and the selected-workspace picker at `/` and `/team/`. Expected Admin menus were updated for Quick start; the final full run passed 5,685 + 60. [Original failure log](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/39d0052739c1d44e4b75f56253f6658be0be4f37/review/admin-quick-start/npm-test.log), [final rerun](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/39d0052739c1d44e4b75f56253f6658be0be4f37/review/admin-quick-start/npm-test-final.log).
- The first coverage capture passed its unit groups, then integration had 1,218 passes and one cancellation: the existing server-stop SIGINT case exceeded its unchanged 5,000 ms bound. It exited 1 and wrote no coverage. A second attempt passed 3,693 unit tests but rejected capture because impact metadata changed during measurement; it also wrote no coverage. After the input freeze, the full selected capture passed and wrote the verified report. No timeout or assertion was weakened. [Timeout attempt](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/39d0052739c1d44e4b75f56253f6658be0be4f37/review/admin-quick-start/coverage-run.log), [input-change rejection](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/39d0052739c1d44e4b75f56253f6658be0be4f37/review/admin-quick-start/coverage-retry.log), [accepted capture](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/39d0052739c1d44e4b75f56253f6658be0be4f37/review/admin-quick-start/coverage-final.log).
- Initial `pnpm exec` dependency verification warned that the temporary `node_modules` symlink was not a real hoist directory; the exact installed dependencies remained usable and the self-hosted gate passed. The first direct hosted-build launch stopped before scripts with `EBADDEVENGINES`: npm's shebang selected system Node 22.14.0 despite a Node 24 runner. Prepending the actual pinned Node 24.20.0 executable directory to the ignored runner's PATH fixed the launch; the unchanged hosted build passed. [Failed launch](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/39d0052739c1d44e4b75f56253f6658be0be4f37/review/admin-quick-start/environment-gates/02-build-hosted.log), [passing retry](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/39d0052739c1d44e4b75f56253f6658be0be4f37/review/admin-quick-start/environment-gates/02b-build-hosted.log).
- The initial read-only browser review identified missing keyboard and expanded narrow-layout evidence. The final driver adds keyboard activation/focus checks and expanded-content overflow assertions; both updated browser cases passed in the 32-test focused run. [Final focused evidence](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/39d0052739c1d44e4b75f56253f6658be0be4f37/review/admin-quick-start/quick-start-final-focused.log).

**Coverage and bounds.** The accepted report is version 3, `own-characters-1`, from Node 24.20.0 and TypeScript 7.0.2. Unit and integration capture manifests are `verified`, captured at `e65d3502`; source/input/build identities are retained in the report. Coverage was not edited. It measures the selected unit/integration suites, not acceptance or live branch coverage. The final-head report verifies compatibility of these retained captures. The formal process is bound to `f5f8cd2e3a2297d73a44fbc2974c6eee5a59d81e`: Delta reports MI goal misses; the two new-file misses have permitted exceptions, and existing-file dispositions are recorded in Quality review. Review, CRAP and Architecture passed. The checker reports **T2 Need architect**, preliminary eligible with `blockers: []`; independent authorized human architect approval of the current candidate is still pending, so overall merge remains blocked. Full metric results, exception reasons, checker evidence and approval status are maintained in [Quality review](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/pull/289#issuecomment-6474822296).

Browser checks compare document `scrollWidth` with `clientWidth` at 320, 390 and 1,024 CSS pixels, both with details closed and with provider/manual content open. Visible Copy-button bounds must be at least 48 CSS pixels high. The browser checks actual local assets/fonts, keyboard operation and browser error collection; the HTML tests verify exact script/style CSP hashes. [320px](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/39d0052739c1d44e4b75f56253f6658be0be4f37/review/admin-quick-start/quick-start-ui/quick-start-320.png), [390px](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/39d0052739c1d44e4b75f56253f6658be0be4f37/review/admin-quick-start/quick-start-ui/quick-start-390.png), [desktop](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/39d0052739c1d44e4b75f56253f6658be0be4f37/review/admin-quick-start/quick-start-ui/quick-start-1024.png), [expanded](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/39d0052739c1d44e4b75f56253f6658be0be4f37/review/admin-quick-start/quick-start-ui/quick-start-expanded.png). Clipboard success/denial uses browser API stubs; VM tests also cover an unavailable API. These prove application feedback and selectable fallback, not native operating-system clipboard permission. External vendor network controls and continued audit-destination delivery are not established by this page or these tests. Existing deadlines, token-expiry waits, guards and assertions were retained.

**N/A, delivery and cleanup.** No separate public Brave search, Render interface, Private PostgreSQL, Audit Collector, or standalone Axiom live gate is selected: their listed production behavior is unchanged. Ordinary tests still exercise their selected Axiom logging cases; the live removal proof uses its own disposable PostgreSQL as required. No additional renderer command was needed because the selected hosted builds run both local renderer files, and the final AMD64 gate exercises its packaged renderer. No release, deployment, image publication, migration, external provider-policy edit, or real customer destination smoke was requested. Habit-hooks results, retained findings/exceptions, architecture impact, and final eligibility are maintained in [Quality review](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/pull/289#issuecomment-6474822296), not treated as passing test results here.

Runtimes stayed pinned: Node 24.20.0, Lightpanda 1.0.0 and patched ast-metrics 0.43.1-thermus.1. Only expected test settings were passed; credential values were not printed or committed. Tests owned Docker/volume and WorkOS fixture cleanup; the container gate labels had no remaining running containers and local port 24443 had no listener afterward. The temporary dependency symlink was removed. Safe logs and identities were copied out of the isolated checkout before cleanup; no global tool or Docker configuration changed.

implementation approval sets product scope; it is not final-candidate approval.
Manager and agent reviews do not supply that human approval. No de-escalation

all empty. The actual T2 tier comes from the semantic flags below, rather than

must verify current checks, holds, and independent human approval. That note
